gen-gf-lugrasimo-general-sans: Lugrasimo writes loose and friendly, with a hand-drawn lean to every word. General Sans, a sans with steady pressure and letters that fill the line, lets long paragraphs glide along without a snag.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Lugrasimo has a mild taper and a loose, hand-drawn stride that feels friendly. BhuTuka Expanded One slows everything to a leisurely walk, while Lugrasimo earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-gf-hepta-slab: Loose, hand-drawn and friendly, Lugrasimo tapers its joins only slightly, never vanishing. Hepta Slab keeps its line weight flat and stretches every word wide, which is the real draw here.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads with generous letterspace and round o rings whose walls never thicken. And Lugrasimo adds soft heavier accents on top, so give Kiwi Maru a little extra size to hold its own.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-gf-orbit: Friendly and hand-drawn, Lugrasimo spreads its line out loosely. Orbit lets each character float apart, curves stopping short on rope-like strokes, so extended paragraphs drift along instead of crowding.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-gf-padyakke-expanded-on: A barely tilted calligraphy nib gives Lugrasimo its hand-drawn look. Padyakke Expanded One, a serif with wide-mouthed c's and no hairlines at all, spreads out beneath it and lends a literary tone.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic is an approachable sans with stroke ends set far apart and a single fixed line. And over a long text it feels like reading one letter at a time, while Lugrasimo shifts weight gently above.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Friendly and loose, Lugrasimo carries a slight but clear stroke modulation, hand-drawn all the way across the line. Stint Ultra Expanded, a serif of pipe-cleaner strokes, steps in underneath.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-gf-syncopate: Syncopate is a sans drawn like a technical pen, constant in weight. Its letters sit spaced like rungs on a rope ladder, a steadiness that Lugrasimo plays against with a loose, hand-drawn line.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-manrope: Manrope keeps a bright open gap at every curve and holds one width throughout. Manrope is best at steady, bright text, while Lugrasimo is best at loose, hand-drawn warmth.
